name: reference-workspace
query:
Set up a private EPD project system for fictional Atlas. Create a new Projects database and shared Tasks, Docs and Meetings collections in an independent private home "Atlas · Projects". Do not touch existing Atlas systems. Main project: Self-serve onboarding—help new teams reach their first shared project without a sales call. Building, lead Priya Shah (Product), Noor Ali (Design), Theo Park (Engineering), target Nov20 2026. Pilot milestone Nov6: setup flow and research review ready. Decision still open: creator cannot invite teammates. Scope setup, first project, invites, activation measurement; billing out of scope.
Tasks: Confirm activation event (Done,Priya,Oct28); Test first-run prototype (Doing,Noor,Nov2); Resolve invite permission edge case (Blocked,Theo,Nov3); Build workspace setup flow (Doing,Theo,Nov6); Prepare launch measurement (To do,Priya,Nov10); Review accessibility (To do,Noor,Nov12). Create useful completion criteria.
Docs: Product brief (Accepted), First-run design review (Review), Decision: invite after first value (Accepted; separate from unresolved inability-to-invite edge case). Develop substantive draft bodies from the supplied facts, labeling elaborations as proposed. Link work to the relevant docs.
Meetings: weekly project reviews Monday30min; prepare Nov2 and Nov9 agendas and an async standup working format. No past meeting outcomes or calendar invitations. Names are fictional text.
Second project: Workspace permissions, Discovery, lead Theo, target Dec4, outcome predictable guest access. One task for it: Map guest access scenarios, To do,Theo,undated. This should remain separate from onboarding work. I want an immediately usable project home with team, tasks, docs and meeting notes.

context.execution: Live testing only when explicitly authorized; isolated private sample destinations. Otherwise supply a stateful mock.
context.reference: Connected EPD workspace: compact portfolio, native metadata, scoped work views and substantive record bodies.

success_criteria: Project is a record in reusable Projects with related Tasks, Docs and Meetings.
First screen exposes status/lead/target, milestone and team; native work tabs.
Onboarding views exclude the second project task; prepared agendas are not claimed scheduled.
No extra design coaching; revised skill alone supplies composition.
Read and visually inspect saved output; failures repaired by runner using skill guidance, not reviewer polish.
Preserve existing comparison pages and unrelated pages.

Two Projects records share Tasks, Docs and Meetings. The main project has six tasks, three docs, two dated agendas and a reusable async standup; any additional meeting format has a distinct purpose and is not fabricated history.
The second project task is excluded from every main-project view; undated second-project work remains available in shared Tasks.
First project screen shows status, lead, target, milestone, team and working tabs; native record layouts are configured.
Every Notion content and settings mutation uses the connected Notion MCP; browser/UI is read-only inspection even when MCP rejects a layout setting.

Essential native status/date metadata remains visible; secondary properties may move out of the main reading flow when they obscure working views. Source properties are retained, and the lead remains legible in the team area.
The full outcome appears once in the first screen. Portfolio cards use a short faithful summary when the full outcome clips, preserving the complete source outcome.
